igniter.source: ASME B1.20.1 (as tabulated in Wikipedia 'National pipe thread', checked 2026-09-25)

warnings.text: LOX channel cross-section 22.8 mm² is 0.50× the 45.2 mm² of orifices it feeds — the channel (and any groove in the cover) is the manifold; SP-8089: as large a cross-section as possible, confirm by cold flow
LOX holes break into a flat floor obliquely: the short wall is L/d 3.5, under SP-8089's 4 — raise the hole L/d or cone the floor

fuel channel cross-section 24.0 mm² is 0.63× the 38.1 mm² of orifices it feeds — the channel (and any groove in the cover) is the manifold; SP-8089: as large a cross-section as possible, confirm by cold flow
fuel holes break into a flat floor obliquely: the short wall is L/d 3.5, under SP-8089's 4 — raise the hole L/d or cone the floor
1/2 NPT needs 13.56 mm of thread (ASME B1.20.1 L2); the plate is 12.70 mm at the port — raise 'Thickness at port' (injector.igniter.hub_thickness) or thicken the plate
